description: Runs a fresh capture of the page behind an earlier full report bought with the same API key, then returns the new result plus `comparison`: every check marked cleared, improved_still_failing, unchanged, regressed, newly_failing or unable_to_verify against that baseline. Use it after the fixes from fix_prompt are published. It needs an API key (Authorization header) and an idempotency_key you reuse on retries. Call it first without confirm to see the quote (the baseline's included re-checks are used first, at 0 credits; after those, 1 credit); nothing runs or is charged until you call again with confirm: true. A failed capture gives the re-check or credit back. Reading results with get_audit_result is always free.

baseline_audit_id.description: The audit_id of the earlier full report (bought with this API key).

confirm.description: true runs the recheck at the quoted cost; omitted or false only returns the quote.

idempotency_key.description: A unique string (8-100 characters, e.g. a UUID) for this recheck. Reuse it when retrying: a retry returns the same run and never charges twice.

language.description: Optional. Must match the baseline report's language.

url.description: Optional. Must be the baseline's own page.

name: recheck_landing_page
title: Recheck a page after fixes and compare with the earlier full report
